mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Fireman's Park with a high of 89 degrees, feeling like 98 degrees.

Starting today, the Verona Senior Center is updating their flooring, which means wellness and outdoor programming will be the focus until September 10. Also, please note that all City facilities will be closed on Monday, September 7, for the Labor Day holiday.

There is plenty to do in town today, including trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
A noteworthy call occurred on August 30 when an officer encountered a vehicle versus bicyclist crash at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street, resulting in a citation for failure to yield.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
